_README: ONE file to rebrand the whole site. Change values, run `node build.js`, upload /dist. Values wrapped in [ ] are PLACEHOLDERS that must be replaced before going live.

brand.name: DUNADRON
brand.name_note: Final brand: DUNADRON. Mark: 4A Sweep (thermal dune-cut D). Favicon and small sizes: 4C Stem.

colors.palette_note: Gradient stops are copied exactly from the 4A Sweep logo SVG (magenta/purple → orange). primary is #E43948 (the 0.58 stop), the first exact stop that meets WCAG AA 4.5:1 for body text on bg #070B12; deeper magentas are used only in the gradient. secondary is #FF8B22. accent is #C52281 (0.45 magenta).

contact.whatsapp_note: International format, digits only, no + or spaces (e.g. 34612345678)
contact.address: Calle Playa de Riazor nº 22, P.4, 28042 Madrid, Spain

site.productionUrl_note: Used only when building with PROD=1 or `npm run build:prod`. The default `url` and previewBanner stay as they are for the GitHub Pages draft.
site.previewBanner_note: true = show a thin 'DRAFT · for partner review' bar and highlight [PLACEHOLDERS]. Set false before going live.

forms.endpoint_note: Optional. Paste a Formspree / Getform / Netlify Forms URL to receive form submissions. If empty, forms open the visitor's email app pre-filled (mailto) to contact.salesEmail.

commerce.mode_note: quote = 'Add to quote' list + request by email/WhatsApp (no payments). Future: 'stripe' or 'shopify' - each product already has price/currency/sku/stock fields.

analytics.note: Leave empty for no tracking. If set, analytics only loads after the visitor accepts cookies.
